cards.title: Feasibility headless и настоящего Scala REPL
cards.behavior: Минимальный reproducer: binding val/def/case class, общий runtime object через classloader/prelude bridge, фоновые fibers, JLine edit buffer, bundled headless invoke. Проверить Scala/JDK/ZIO/artifacts и HTTP/schema candidates; записать exact версии, startup/memory и рекомендуемый adapter.

acceptance.normal: SPIKE-01: clean запуск, сохранённые transcript и version inventory; отдельный headless процесс без terminal/compiler classpath.
acceptance.error: SPIKE-02: compile error сохраняет старый binding; missing toolchain/artifact явно unavailable.
acceptance.concurrency: SPIKE-03: Ctrl+C foreground/await/idle и SIGTERM runner без orphan; background output не портит строку.

cards.non_goals: Production runtime, fake Scala parser, обещание стабильного bind API; этот prototype не release.

cards.title: Frozen публичные API и versioned схемы
cards.behavior: Compile-only Program/Agent/Workflow/Task/Job/Child, launch facade capability, all overloads, pipeline/verify/check codecs, backend events/errors. JSON schemas input/context/run/result/bundle/checks. DefinitionContext явно предоставляется REPL/loader; no global launch in imports.

acceptance.normal: API-01: positive Scala fixtures для apply/andThen/all heterogeneous tuple/map/for/fork/pipeline; roundtrip canonical schemas.
acceptance.error: API-02: negative fixtures wrong input/mixed Programs/Task output/unknown schema version; error family с stable exit mapping.
acceptance.concurrency: API-03: construction/printer не исполняет backend; immutable descriptors можно разделять без runtime mutation.

cards.non_goals: Рабочие transports/REPL, Any/casts на public boundary, второй DSL parser.

cards.title: Pinned build и разделение distributions
cards.behavior: Канонический sbt multi-project, exact tool versions, JDK policy, dependency resolution и build inventory. Run/dev module dependency graph: core не знает compiler, testkit вне production. Bootstrap не скрывается внутри tests.

acceptance.normal: BUILD-01: clean compile всех skeleton modules; dependency tree и headless distribution исключают compiler/JLine.
acceptance.error: BUILD-02: unsupported JDK/missing tool объявляется до build; no floating versions/snapshots.
acceptance.concurrency: BUILD-03: два независимых clean builds дают одинаковый dependency inventory; build не запускает model/tools.

cards.non_goals: Полноценный packaging/release, auto-install во время quality gate.

cards.title: Quality runner, classifier и evidence
cards.behavior: Protected argv registry, diff classifier для merge-base/staged/unstaged/untracked/rename/delete/unborn, required profiles, timeout/partial logs, source/policy/toolchain/log hashes. evidence --require проверяет freshness/completeness, не summary автора.

acceptance.normal: GATE-01: fast/changed/full и profile commands генерируют валидный manifest; selected risky path включает правильные profiles.
acceptance.error: GATE-02: fabricated/stale log, missing tool, skipped gate, changed threshold/registry и evidence write failure nonzero.
acceptance.concurrency: GATE-03: timeout/SIGTERM сохраняет partial report, concurrent source edit invalidates run; gates не rewrite source.

cards.non_goals: Ослабление coverage/thresholds, paid inference, использование shell для registry argv.

cards.title: Profiles, policies и независимый provider config
cards.behavior: Versioned immutable config, env credential refs, model roles, explicit defaults, endpoint/auth/version normalization, runtime ceilings и trust ownership. OpenAI-compatible/Anthropic-compatible/Yabanin доступны одинаково; цены nullable и источник известен.

acceptance.normal: CFG-01: три profiles и mixed-role resolution без service calls, API prefix сохранён; bounded env credential resolution.
acceptance.error: CFG-02: missing role/key, duplicate names, insecure remote URL, invalid cap и unknown required option before dispatch; redact diagnostics.
acceptance.concurrency: CFG-03: running snapshot не меняется при reload; overrides только сужают capabilities/ceilings.

cards.non_goals: HTTP calls, secret literals, implicit gateway/direct failover, mint keys.

cards.title: Deterministic testkit без LLM
cards.behavior: Scripted ModelBackend/tool outcomes, virtual time, controllable promises/barriers, request recorder, simulated usage/errors/partial events. Fixture mode маркирован; core contract suites переиспользуемы любым backend.

acceptance.normal: MOCK-01: text/tool/tool-result/final, scripted price/unknown usage и ordered event traces.
acceptance.error: MOCK-02: invalid fixture, unexpected call, overread, output bound не превращаются в success.
acceptance.concurrency: MOCK-03: virtual deadline/backoff, controllable cancellation/finish races без real sleeps.

cards.non_goals: Network client, смешение mock и live, dependency testkit в production classpath.

cards.title: Job registry и atomic lifecycle
cards.behavior: Typed Job handle, heterogeneous admin views только с codecs, IDs/root lineage, queued/running/waiting/terminal transitions, shared completion и bounded retention. Admission остаётся отдельным service.

acceptance.normal: JOB-01: start/read/await terminal outcome, два await не повторяют backend, несколько roots независимы.
acceptance.error: JOB-02: unknown ID, invalid transition, duplicate terminal event дают typed errors/late observations.
acceptance.concurrency: JOB-03: many waiters + cancel/success race: один terminal winner/result, no lost waiter.

cards.non_goals: Database/daemon, unbounded forever registry, costs/tools implementation.

cards.title: Structured scopes и отмена subtree
cards.behavior: CI/REPL owner→root→scoped child, cancellation-safe registration/finalizers, bounded cleanup, no new dispatch after Cancelling. Domain failure и interruption различимы.

acceptance.normal: SCOPE-01: join/scoped exit/all fail cancel unjoined children; root completes после mandatory finalizers.
acceptance.error: SCOPE-02: cleanup failure/grace exhaustion отражаются Interrupted/Uncertain согласно evidence, не fake Cancelled.
acceptance.concurrency: SCOPE-03: interrupt ровно между child launch/register; no orphan, one completion и permit cleanup.

cards.non_goals: Detached daemon jobs, Future/Await/global runtime, обещание remote cancellation по TCP close.

cards.title: Root budget и admission без deadlocks
cards.behavior: Atomic exact money ledger/reservations/settlement, attempts/tokens/depth/children/queue/model/tool ceilings. Price unknown explicit; retries и output repair расходуют root cap. Fair bounded queues и deadline during wait.

acceptance.normal: BUD-01: concurrent children суммы<=declared bounded admission; exact rounding/overflow; mixed-provider root.
acceptance.error: BUD-02: неизвестная цена при required hard USD cap rejected, negative/overflow config не запускается.
acceptance.concurrency: BUD-03: parent delegate+join при model slots=1 не deadlock; cancel на каждой acquisition boundary release correctly.

cards.non_goals: Pipeline-wide distributed hard cap, Double money, post-hoc polling как admission.

cards.title: Native agent loop
cards.behavior: Freeze profile/tools/model/context, normalize requests/events, complete tool arguments validation/policy, bounded retry/steps, final output validation. Runnable delegate primitive после limits; LLM-driven profile selection checked registry.

acceptance.normal: LOOP-01: text→tool→result→final и child delegation со scoped ownership; attempt/ToolCall IDs сохранены.
acceptance.error: LOOP-02: invalid arguments/schema/unknown tool/profile, provider error, max steps/depth rejected без side effect.
acceptance.concurrency: LOOP-03: cancel during stream/tool/join; partial tool args не execute; retries bounded и billed attempts distinct.

cards.non_goals: Compaction/full typed repair, внешние engines единственным runtime, trusted verdict из ответа модели.

cards.title: OpenAI-compatible HTTP Chat
cards.behavior: Nonstreaming Chat serialization/auth/tool rounds/errors/usage, API prefix/TLS/redirect behavior, bounded body/timeouts. Endpoint model configured без обязательного /models; normalize actual vs requested metadata.

acceptance.normal: CHAT-01: реальный local HTTP mock принимает request/tool IDs и отдаёт text/tool/usage outcomes без Yabanin.
acceptance.error: CHAT-02: 401/403/429/5xx/malformed/oversize/unsupported-required classified, auth не уходит на другой origin.
acceptance.concurrency: CHAT-03: cancel request/body closes resources; ambiguous paid attempts не обнуляют usage и не repeat tools.

cards.non_goals: Responses, Azure/cloud auth ecosystem, gateway-specific headers в generic adapter.

cards.title: OpenAI SSE streaming state machine
cards.behavior: Incremental UTF-8/SSE framing и normalized deltas, interleaved tool indices/arguments, usage-only data, finish_reason/DONE/EOF policy. Reusable framing может использовать Anthropic, semantic parser отдельный.

acceptance.normal: SSE-01: все chunk partitions sanitized corpus дают одинаковый output/usage/tool IDs.
acceptance.error: SSE-02: truncated frames/oversize/invalid JSON/EOF-before-finish/idle timeout typed fail, no partial tool execution.
acceptance.concurrency: SSE-03: slow consumer/cancel/finish race bounded buffers, closed response и truthful accounting.

cards.non_goals: Assume one chunk=one event, unbounded concatenation, переписывание protocol fixtures под parser.

cards.title: Anthropic-compatible Messages и streaming
cards.behavior: Самостоятельный Messages wire: system/content blocks/tool_use/tool_result, max_tokens/auth/version, indexed SSE block lifecycle/partial JSON/cumulative usage. Capability-specific metadata roundtrip и privacy без fake OpenAI conversion.

acceptance.normal: ANTH-01: local HTTP full tool round и text stream, equivalent native outcome без Yabanin env; multiple tools/errors.
acceptance.error: ANTH-02: refusal/truncation/error-after-200/unknown required block/incomplete stream/version-auth mismatch truthful errors.
acceptance.concurrency: ANTH-03: fragmented UTF-8/tool input и cancel между block_stop/message_stop; once tool execute, usage не суммирует cumulative twice.

cards.non_goals: Server-managed tools/cloud adapters/all beta features, logging thinking/signatures, silently dropped unsupported semantics.

cards.title: Чтение и поиск с workspace containment
cards.behavior: Bounded read/search, realpath/workspace policy, UTF-8/binary behavior и output truncation evidence. Не делать shell concatenation для search. File artifacts provenance/hash.

acceptance.normal: READ-01: temporary repo read/search returns correct ranges и bounded result, empty query/file defined.
acceptance.error: READ-02: traversal/symlink escape/permission/binary/oversize отказ или declared truncation без secret dump.
acceptance.concurrency: READ-03: deleted/changed file during read gets defined error/provenance; cancellation stops long search.

cards.non_goals: Write/process tools, обещание полноценного OS sandbox.

cards.title: Безопасная мутация и patch artifacts
cards.behavior: Expected SHA/content preconditions, atomic replace, diff bounds/encoding, symlink-aware write policy, patch/baseSha artifact. Default serialized writers, explicit isolated worktrees для параллельных agents.

acceptance.normal: EDIT-01: apply approved patch only matching base; record resulting hash/diff, no unrelated paths.
acceptance.error: EDIT-02: stale expected hash/path escape/protected verifier/invalid diff fail without partial silent mutation.
acceptance.concurrency: EDIT-03: two writers stale conflict predictable; cancel pre/during commit records applied/uncertain status.

cards.non_goals: Auto commit/push/merge, exactly-once after crash, изменение verifier в agent workspace.

cards.title: Owned process tools и isolated execution
cards.behavior: Structured argv/cwd/env allowlist, output/time bounds, process groups/grace escalation и sandbox capability negotiation. CI untrusted tests только credential-free isolated worker; unavailable isolation→deny.

acceptance.normal: PROC-01: registered command fixture в temp workspace, captured exit/output и no inherited credentials.
acceptance.error: PROC-02: invalid argv/cwd/policy/missing sandbox/oversize/timeouts fail honestly; no raw shell interpolation.
acceptance.concurrency: PROC-03: SIGTERM/cancel kills owned grandchildren, PID reuse/foreign process не kill; unresolved remote process Uncertain.

cards.non_goals: Docker daemon setup, privileged mounts, host sandbox guarantee из одного env filtering.

cards.title: Единая typed composition
cards.behavior: andThen/mapOutput, all Programs/Tasks arity2 typed tuples, ordered bounded batch/batchCollect, scope/fork/join. One effect interpreter; external cancellation не swallowed в collect.

acceptance.normal: COMP-01: mixed typed tuple, sequential ordering, ordered batch, empty batch no dispatch и explicit input contexts.
acceptance.error: COMP-02: negative inference fixtures/mismatched inputs/invalid parallelism; fail-fast cancels siblings.
acceptance.concurrency: COMP-03: bounded fanout/root ledger и scope exit; max model permit1 parent waiting no deadlock.

cards.non_goals: Macros, dynamic List[Any], race/quorum до P2, отдельный scheduler.

cards.title: Ergonomic REPL launch facade
cards.behavior: ask/start/run/await/send/cancel/watch/info на Program/Task/Job через using ReplSession, method/infix/functional aliases delegates one launch. Foreground/root observer cancellation ownership explicit.

acceptance.normal: FACADE-01: primary DSL fixtures возвращают typed result/Job; repeated await no calls; prelude first answer.
acceptance.error: FACADE-02: missing session и blocking facade inside workflow give clear errors; bare Task never run.
acceptance.concurrency: FACADE-03: CtrlC foreground subtree vs await/watch observer different behavior; session close owns roots.

cards.non_goals: Hidden global runtime, смена apply eager semantics, arbitrary persistent closures.

cards.title: Pinned compiler/JLine REPL adapter
cards.behavior: Real Scala eval/completion/multiline, shared type/classloader context, single terminal writer/coalescing, session lifecycle/signal ownership. Compiler imports only engine adapter; state reset explicit.

acceptance.normal: REPL-01: val/def/case class/import/Unicode/load, old bindings после compile error и no output duplication.
acceptance.error: REPL-02: runtime error/EOF/bad pasted source restores prompt; pretty-print secrets/tasks safe.
acceptance.concurrency: REPL-03: 20 streaming jobs vs editing buffer; CtrlC modes; reset/exit no orphan/fiber; PTY actual process.

cards.non_goals: Fake Interpreter acceptance, Windows support без suite, compiler in headless distribution.

cards.title: Prelude, registry commands и definition load
cards.behavior: Presets, help/jobs/watch/cancel/agents/tools/workflows/load/run/spawn/doctor/reset/exit. DefinitionContext+explicit register/version snapshot; quoted paths parsed without shell. Load trusted code without command-history replay.

acceptance.normal: CMD-01: help alone позволяет seven UX scenarios; load/register/run same Program и preview IDs.
acceptance.error: CMD-02: unknown ID/workflow/wrong input/bad path/code reports line+column, previous definitions retained.
acceptance.concurrency: CMD-03: reload while running leaves pinned old snapshot; exit/reset handles jobs, inbox/watch subscriptions.

cards.non_goals: Interactive prompt in CI, binary plugin hot reload, fabricated built-in upstream parity.

cards.title: Steering mailbox и checked model delegation
cards.behavior: Bounded ordered steering receipts queued/applied/rejected with safe-boundary consumption. Delegate registered profile/version/schema/context/capability subset; join releases active model permit.

acceptance.normal: MSG-01: send affects next turn; model delegate child inherits RootId/policy/limits, typed outcome reference.
acceptance.error: MSG-02: finished job/full inbox/unauthorized profile/wrong child input/depth cap rejects with receipt.
acceptance.concurrency: MSG-03: send/cancel/finish race no lost receipt; recursive delegation stops admission; parent cancellation owns child.

cards.non_goals: Unbounded freeform cross-root bus, daemon messaging, передачa parent credentials/full transcript по умолчанию.

cards.title: Compiled bundles и headless Runner
cards.behavior: Compile trusted definitions/registers→versioned JAR manifest; headless load validated bundle/input/workflow and run same Task. dev source shorthand explicit compilation; stdout JSON/noANSI, stderr diagnostics, no stdin dependence.

acceptance.normal: RUN-01: packaged runner executes mock Program from bundle with closed stdin, no compiler/JLine/network resolution.
acceptance.error: RUN-02: bad hash/API/dependency/schema/name/input fails preflight before spend, output failure typed.
acceptance.concurrency: RUN-03: invocation owns root cleanup; SIGTERM bounded stop, concurrent invocations have separate state directories.

cards.non_goals: Trust from bare hash, executing fork-supplied bundle with credentials, second interpreter/runtime.

cards.title: CI context и trust preflight
cards.behavior: Generic schema plus GitHub/GitLab env adapters, provenance/bounded metadata/matrix/retry identity and explicit owner trust. Protected bundle/verifier/policy sources independent of target workspace. Required policy checked before dispatch.

acceptance.normal: CTX-01: same semantics from equivalent three contexts; fresh roots and stable logical identity.
acceptance.error: CTX-02: ambiguous auto platform/malformed missing context/untrusted trust escalation fail; no raw env export.
acceptance.concurrency: CTX-03: concurrent matrix/retry distinct attribution; fork config cannot widen permissions or access keys.

cards.non_goals: CI DAG/runner scheduling, network repo hosting API calls, trusting env flag alone.

cards.title: Trusted checks, artifacts и exit contracts
cards.behavior: MVP deterministic verifier/check registry outside agent workspace, report-format/input/output schema checks; frozen advisory/blocking policy. Atomic run/result/events/JUnit/summary/artifacts manifests и stable error precedence; actual check evidence.

acceptance.normal: REPORT-01: success/finding advisory/blocking failure → expected run verdict/exit, hashes/XML match actual outputs.
acceptance.error: REPORT-02: diskfull/permission/secret/log-command/XML/path injection; every exit mapping table-driven incl. uncertainty.
acceptance.concurrency: REPORT-03: signal finalization while output writing сохраняет truthful partial state; no fake passed checks from model.

cards.non_goals: Task eval benchmark suite (041), SARIF publisher/PR writes, self-hash recursive manifest, green при reporter error.

cards.title: GitHub/GitLab/generic wrappers
cards.behavior: Thin templates CLI+safe summary/scalar outputs+artifact upload/JUnit mapping; pinned third-party refs. Generic context example works without host vendor SDK. Default permissions/read-only/fork mock; paid/live/publish explicit.

acceptance.normal: PLAT-01: local env/template/schema fixtures; clean hosted runner transcripts when owner has configured infrastructure.
acceptance.error: PLAT-02: untrusted multiline summary/output/::command/PR title not executed, no secret dotenv; missing hosted run pending.
acceptance.concurrency: PLAT-03: matrix identities/interruptible/retry preserve truthful artifacts and avoid blind mutation replay.

cards.non_goals: Universal cloud orchestrator, auto configure repo secrets, publication/posts, claim readiness по YAML alone.

cards.title: Совместная MVP-приёмка
cards.behavior: One deterministic vertical slice: review/advisory, patch+checks, research output; same workflow CI/REPL, standalone оба wires, mixed providers. Acceptance matrix limits/cancel/error/artifact/trust explicitly exported.

acceptance.normal: MVP-01: product CLI and PTY transcripts pass; generic/GitHub/GitLab fixture semantic equivalence, no Yabanin dependency.
acceptance.error: MVP-02: missing creds/unsupported tools/invalid output/provider error/budget/deadline/check fail/report failure nonzero.
acceptance.concurrency: MVP-03: two async children+steering+join/cancel; maxLLM1; SIGTERM owned process cleanup and no leak.

cards.non_goals: Live spend, asserting hosted CI without evidence, beta/P2 features; unresolved defect gets dedicated fix card.

cards.title: Journal и архивирование без replay
cards.behavior: Versioned event envelope, single writer/atomic snapshots, root sequences, bounded retention/redaction, archived views. Recovery invalid tail: interrupted/uncertain, no auto replay mutation/closure.

acceptance.normal: JOURNAL-01: events/results roundtrip and root/job lineage; archive available after restart.
acceptance.error: JOURNAL-02: corrupt tail/unknown schema/disk error marked incomplete; raw keys/prompts absent по policy.
acceptance.concurrency: JOURNAL-03: slow writer observer не blocks budget; bounded overflow defined, final flush errors honest.

cards.non_goals: Arbitrary Scala durable resume, SQL persistence без измерений, fake durable guarantee при dropped events.

cards.title: Typed agents, tools и bounded output repair
cards.behavior: Tool[I,O] и Agent[I,O] с едиными codec/schema derivation, structured outputs и runtime validation; beta all arity 3/4 с heterogeneous tuple inference. Endpoint native schema mode optional; bounded repair charged attempts; derive macro только стандартная typeclass mechanism, не compiler AST DSL.

acceptance.normal: TYPE-01: case class/enum/nested codec tests, typed chain inference, tool inputs roundtrip обоих wires.
acceptance.error: TYPE-02: invalid JSON/unknown required field/schema mismatch/unsupported native capability, no unchecked casting.
acceptance.concurrency: TYPE-03: repair retry cap и root reservation с cancel/deadline; repeated bad output ends Failed.

cards.non_goals: Общий schema framework с нуля, unlimited model repair, research-verdict из LLM.

cards.title: Definition loaders и context policy
cards.behavior: Native Markdown/TOML/Scala definitions, provenance/version snapshot, instructions hierarchy/cwd/context policy, bounded resource refs. Reuse DefinitionContext; policy intersection, missing references typed.

acceptance.normal: LOAD-01: equivalent native profile definitions и source hashes, versioned registry roundtrip.
acceptance.error: LOAD-02: malformed frontmatter/unsupported required key/traversal/context secret leakage denied.
acceptance.concurrency: LOAD-03: reload affects new roots only; child TaskOnly vs Summary/Artifacts limits explicit.

cards.non_goals: Upstream importer semantics (032/033), executing untrusted Scala plugin, auto replay history.

cards.title: Context limits и compaction
cards.behavior: Model context capability/estimate, pinned instruction/task/tool history, artifact refs, explicit compaction checkpoint. Summary cost charged; preserve tool correlation and unsent steering; uncertain token estimate visible.

acceptance.normal: CTXMEM-01: long scripted conversation bounded, preserves task/tools/results needed for next request.
acceptance.error: CTXMEM-02: missing tokenizer/context size/compaction invalid/schema errors fail by policy, not silent truncation essentials.
acceptance.concurrency: CTXMEM-03: compaction vs steering/cancel race deterministic; job version/model role retained.

cards.non_goals: Magic infinite memory, embedding/vector DB/RAG platform, summary as task verifier.

cards.title: Versioned JVM plugin SPI
cards.behavior: Manifest/API range/IDs/dependencies/tools/providers/agents/middleware permissions. Immutable registry, deterministic hook order, scoped lifecycle; plugin code trusted with process authority. Invalid compatibility blocks load.

acceptance.normal: EXT-01: external example plugin registers typed tool+profile/provider via public SPI; no core changes.
acceptance.error: EXT-02: duplicate ID/API mismatch/cyclic deps/hook timeout/prohibited capability fail preflight.
acceptance.concurrency: EXT-03: hook failure cannot bypass root ceiling/cancel; concurrent jobs use pinned registry.

cards.non_goals: Sandbox произвольной JVM, TS plugin interpreter, runtime binary hot reload, marketplace.

cards.title: Pi profile importer с provenance
cards.behavior: Pin upstream commit/license/hash, import example scout/planner/reviewer/worker prompts+supported tool/context semantics into Raider profiles; compatibility report exact supported/ignored/rejected fields.

acceptance.normal: PIIMP-01: golden upstream corpus maps profiles/tool policies and notices reproducibly.
acceptance.error: PIIMP-02: unknown required tools/extensions/config rejected or explicit degraded opt-in, no false parity.
acceptance.concurrency: PIIMP-03: imported snapshot reload не mutates running child policy; effective capabilities only narrow.

cards.non_goals: Copy всей архитектуры, claim встроенных pi subagents, execution TS extensions в JVM.

cards.title: OpenCode profile importer
cards.behavior: Pin upstream version/commit; Markdown/JSON profiles вместе с registry permissions/mode defaults, primary build/plan и subagent roles per actual version. Ask/deny/allow fidelity and unsupported permission patterns report.

acceptance.normal: OCIMP-01: golden prompts+policy profile corpus и license notices, requested permissions mapped.
acceptance.error: OCIMP-02: unsupported tool/wildcard/mode/ask-in-CI cannot silently become allow.
acceptance.concurrency: OCIMP-03: native parent policy intersects imported child; registry versions immutable.

cards.non_goals: All OpenCode config ecosystem/native TS plugins, carry prompt без permission semantics.

cards.title: Pi RPC external backend
cards.behavior: Owned pinned pi process, JSONL stdin/stdout protocol, stderr separate, LF framing, request IDs; acceptance vs actual agent_settled completion. capabilities tools/cancel/nested accounting accurately advertised.

acceptance.normal: PIRPC-01: complete prompt/tool run event normalization through real compatible test process; version recorded.
acceptance.error: PIRPC-02: accepted prompt not treated final, stdout noise/corrupt JSON/crash/version mismatch fail.
acceptance.concurrency: PIRPC-03: Unicode separators are data; retry events not early-complete; process cancel acknowledgement/uncertainty truthful.

cards.non_goals: Native tool-policy enforcement without bridge support, visibility полного upstream billing, silent backend fallback.

cards.title: OpenCode HTTP external backend
cards.behavior: Pinned session/prompt_async/events/abort APIs, directory/workspace ownership и auth; existing remote server optional external lifecycle contract. Shared global SSE filtering by session/request IDs, reconnect policy no mutation replay.

acceptance.normal: OCBACK-01: compatible local server fixture executes session/tool run to actual completion, version capabilities visible.
acceptance.error: OCBACK-02: auth/version/session mismatch/disconnect fail honest; unknown required guarantee blocks launch.
acceptance.concurrency: OCBACK-03: two roots concurrent session events не mix; abort ack vs requested abort different outcomes.

cards.non_goals: Trust arbitrary unauthenticated network server, hard complete nested accounting, invent endpoint shapes.

cards.title: Conversation sessions с serialized turns
cards.behavior: Conversation implements Program, apply lazy, ask/start same verbs; bounded ordered turns, durable archive codec, X-Session-ID scope independent child histories. close and queued-turn cancellation defined.

acceptance.normal: SESSION-01: two turns use context then archive/reopen explicit; one provider turn at a time.
acceptance.error: SESSION-02: closed/unknown/schema-invalid session and oversize history errors, no implicit agent restart.
acceptance.concurrency: SESSION-03: concurrent start/close/cancel/steering preserve order and root ownership; no dropped queued receipts.

cards.non_goals: Daemon persistence active fibers, concurrent writes shared conversation transcript, arbitrary REPL binding restore.

cards.title: Optional Yabanin profile, labels и wrapper env
cards.behavior: Profile decorator/capability doctor без token spend, Go PathEscape golden labels/limits/provenance, decision metadata. yb ci exec child URL/key/labels recognized, explicit lifecycle owner wrapper; standalone generic paths untouched.

acceptance.normal: YBCON-01: mock gateway labels sorted/canonical and effective context; wrapper-first launch child-only env.
acceptance.error: YBCON-02: 401/403/501/stale models docs/label overflow distinguished; no direct provider fallback.
acceptance.concurrency: YBCON-03: matrix roots/attempts distinct; merging wrapper labels preserves protected CI attribution.

cards.non_goals: Changes в Go Yabanin, mint lifecycle (038), claim deployed readiness от read-only snapshot.

cards.title: Yabanin root session keys и finish
cards.behavior: disabled/optional/required modes, parent capability preflight/mint TTL/root labels, opaque credential refs, idempotent finish/revoke policy. inherited ybs_ uses wrapper owner and не mint второй key.

acceptance.normal: YBKEY-01: one key per standalone root+children, complete finish/mock usage and owner recorded.
acceptance.error: YBKEY-02: required unavailable/permission/mint fallback blocks; optional degraded explicit; credentials never artifacts.
acceptance.concurrency: YBKEY-03: cancel vs mint/finish, revoke errors/root failure/accounting pending; no leaking key or fake remote cancelled.

cards.title: Pinned Yabanin stand acceptance
cards.behavior: Owner-provided Yabanin checkout/version/stand with mock upstream, migration/logger/accounting prerequisites; source snapshot refresh, actual deployment capability report. Session/labels/cache/tool/stream behavior measured.

acceptance.normal: YBSTAND-01: real gateway+logger→usage labels and complete flag, no paid provider; artifact/transcript.
acceptance.error: YBSTAND-02: unavailable stand/migrations/DB/keys → unavailable non-pass; unsupported cap priced unknown.
acceptance.concurrency: YBSTAND-03: concurrent children/usage lag/cache duplicate tool/cancel/finish, no zero-unknown or blind replay.

cards.non_goals: Deploy production, modifying sibling code, paid smoke without owner cap, treating polling stable as complete.

cards.title: Agent-eval contract export
cards.behavior: Versioned Yabanin JSON Schema 2020-12 manifest/episodes/calls/tools/verdicts export, separate outcomes/usage coverage/unknown prices null; tool args digests and artifact hashes. Works standalone without server.

acceptance.normal: EXPORT-01: validate all files against pinned schemas/golden fixtures; reconstruct root/job/attempt lineage.
acceptance.error: EXPORT-02: missing actual verifier cannot fabricated verdict; unknown price/completeness retained, secrets absent.
acceptance.concurrency: EXPORT-03: interrupted run/cancel emits consistent partial episodes; late usage reconciliation versioned.

cards.non_goals: Direct DB write/dashboard changes, LLM self-grading, paid eval within ordinary gates.

cards.title: Protected task eval и adversarial corpus
cards.behavior: 12 deterministic loop fixtures+6 real task fixtures, protected verifier registry outside mutable workspace, coding regression/diff constraints/research source checks, safety/protocol hard gates vs soft usefulness. Corpus changes independent review.

acceptance.normal: EVAL-01: seeded review bug/safe edit/bugfix/extraction/parallel synthesis/research detect correct vs planted wrong outcomes.
acceptance.error: EVAL-02: deleting tests/verifier tamper/claim success/no actual check/traversal cannot pass; holdout not exposed.
acceptance.concurrency: EVAL-03: failing sibling/cancel/truncated evidence/artifact hash change cannot produce accepted root.

cards.non_goals: Benchmark leaderboard из одного paid trial, changing gate thresholds alongside product fix.

cards.title: Accounting reconciliation без ложных денег
cards.behavior: Join local attempts with available gateway metadata/session usage; estimates/observed/unpriced/uncertain/pending separate. Bounded lag polling, rounding/source provenance, incomplete final report honest; standalone price catalog paths retained.

acceptance.normal: COST-01: priced/unpriced/unknown/retry fixtures produce correct exact totals and coverage across mixed roots.
acceptance.error: COST-02: missing request ID/usage permission/logger/price never becomes zero/complete; post-hoc over-cost distinct.
acceptance.concurrency: COST-03: finish/poll/cancel/late settlement idempotence; concurrent cap tests measure actual overshoot contract.

cards.non_goals: Shared cross-job hard cap, forged prices, гарантия отмены upstream через revoke.

cards.title: Soak и calibrated performance
cards.behavior: Measure native submission/cancel, headless bundle verify/start, 20 streaming jobs prompt, 1000 bounded jobs memory/registry/fibers/process handles. Save reference machine/JDK/load; relative regression threshold ADR, no random sleeps.

acceptance.normal: PERF-01: budgets quality-gates §10 на calibrated runner; post-cleanup steady memory и no orphans.
acceptance.error: PERF-02: slow renderer/journal/backend observers bounded, stress oversized queue pressure remains controlled.
acceptance.concurrency: PERF-03: mixed launch/cancel/deadline/finish sustained load fair admission no deadlock; report quantiles.

cards.non_goals: Lower threshold ради green, model/network latency как runtime overhead, distributed scalability claim.

cards.title: JVM/OCI distribution и supply-chain inventory
cards.behavior: Separate run/dev launchers, Linux OCI nonroot/pinned base digest, SBOM/licenses/checksums/dependency inventory, offline runtime launch. PID1 signal forwarding and artifact volume UID/path contract. Artifact deterministic metadata.

acceptance.normal: PKG-01: clean-directory install/run/dev REPL; headless no compiler dependencies, container output files usable.
acceptance.error: PKG-02: corrupted bundle/checksum/incompatible JDK/missing writable mount fail; secrets not image/layers.
acceptance.concurrency: PKG-03: SIGTERM container owned subtree cleanup; launcher propagates exit, no signal swallow.

cards.non_goals: Native-image, publishing/signing без owner policy, Windows support без suite.

cards.title: CI разработки самого Raider
cards.behavior: PR risk gates и merge-base, main/nightly full/Linux + macOS compiler/package smoke, release optional integration lanes. Pinned actions/toolchain, fork secret isolation, validated fingerprints and artifact upload on failure.

acceptance.normal: DEV-CI-01: actual clean build job outputs manifest/logs; gates verify same source fingerprint.
acceptance.error: DEV-CI-02: failing/skipped scanner/missing prerequisite/stale cache/artifact writer fail pipeline, no continue-on-error hiding.
acceptance.concurrency: DEV-CI-03: source changes while gate running stale; forks cannot change protected policy to self-green.

cards.non_goals: Product platform adapter (025), secrets provisioning/deploy, claiming executed CI от YAML only.

cards.title: Executable examples и документация
cards.behavior: Quick CI/direct-provider/repl onboarding и review/patch/research examples, upstream import report, integration limitations; every public snippet compiled/mock-executed. Separate sketches labelled and concrete domain fixture codecs provided.

acceptance.normal: DOC-01: newcomer uses short help/README, same definition REPL→bundle→CI, both direct protocols no Yabanin.
acceptance.error: DOC-02: stale command/broken link/uncompiled snippet/unlabelled mock fails docs gate.
acceptance.concurrency: DOC-03: cancel/limits/policy examples match actual runtime; reload/show archived does not replay.

cards.non_goals: Marketing quality claims без evidence, documenting planned P2 as shipped.

cards.title: Release candidate acceptance
cards.behavior: Supported capability matrix standalone/protocol/CI/REPL/platform; immutable fingerprint and validated package artifacts, known limitations. Advertised optional Yabanin/bridges требуют accepted 039/042/034/035 respective evidence; base release independent.

acceptance.normal: REL-01: clean distributions and full acceptance matrices pass; owner receives commands/transcripts/evidence verifier.
acceptance.error: REL-02: missing capability evidence/license/signing policy/failed required checks blocks relevant release claim.
acceptance.concurrency: REL-03: cancel/OOM/incomplete artifacts/retry caveats present, no false exactly-once/shared-cap claims.

cards.non_goals: Automatic publish/tag/push, paid provider cap, calling unsupported integrations ready.

cards.title: Daemon attach и explicit job ownership
cards.behavior: Сначала ADR auth/transport/root ownership/reparent/TTL/quota, затем local daemon start/attach/list/cancel. Detached roots only explicit capability; REPL exit semantics documented.

acceptance.normal: DAEMON-01: disconnect/attach retains owned daemon job; daemon shutdown bounded cleanup.
acceptance.error: DAEMON-02: unauthorized clients/stale handles/expired root/schema mismatch denied.
acceptance.concurrency: DAEMON-03: client disconnect vs cancel/reparent race gives one owner/terminal result.

cards.non_goals: Distributed cluster, restart running fibers, changing default REPL exit silently.

cards.title: Recovery только registered serializable plans
cards.behavior: Design plan IR/registered step identities/checkpoints/side-effect recovery policy. Persist definitions/codecs/version/hash; resume only explicitly recoverable steps, uncertain mutation pauses reconciliation.

acceptance.normal: RECOVER-01: interrupted read-only registered plan reconstructs and resumes from validated checkpoint.
acceptance.error: RECOVER-02: unknown version/closure/nonidempotent step/changed workspace/missing receipt refuses replay.
acceptance.concurrency: RECOVER-03: crash at dispatch/commit/checkpoint boundaries no automatic duplicate mutation; racing resume one owner.

cards.non_goals: Serialize arbitrary Scala closures/JVM stack, exactly-once from JSONL alone.

cards.title: Shared budget authority между CI jobs
cards.behavior: Отдельный design authority/admission/reservation/expiry/reconciliation protocol с failure closed/availability policy. Pipeline/matrix roots используют одно trusted budget, price guarantees declared. Adapter to existing gateway only if real contract supports.

acceptance.normal: SHARE-01: separate processes simultaneous reservations never exceed declared authority cap.
acceptance.error: SHARE-02: partition/timeout/unknown price/stale authority не masquerades local guaranteed cap.
acceptance.concurrency: SHARE-03: orphan lease/late charges/duplicate settlement/retry concurrent tests preserve ledger invariants.

cards.non_goals: Polling usage as atomic admission, guarantees at unavailable upstream boundaries.

cards.title: Capped live сравнение моделей
cards.behavior: Owner-approved accounts/endpoints/spend cap; same task/tools/budget fixtures multiple repetitions, actual requested/served model, cost/latency/uncertainty. Pilot>=3 repeats, stronger conclusions требуют выборки/confidence intervals.

acceptance.normal: LIVE-01: report task/safety/protocol separately, real attempts и costs with provenance.
acceptance.error: LIVE-02: unpriced/missing accounting/budget cutoff/provider outage remain explicit invalid/incomplete trials.
acceptance.concurrency: LIVE-03: parallel runs spend managed by declared cap authority, cancel and retry attempts included.

cards.non_goals: Implicit paid gate/full, ranking из single lucky response, account entitlement assumptions.

cards.title: raceSuccess/quorum coordination
cards.behavior: ADR precise winner/loser cancellation, no-first-error raceSuccess, quorum equivalence key typed results/tie policy/cost. Operations explicit opt-in поверх одного runtime.

acceptance.normal: QUORUM-01: first successful validated result или k-equivalent outputs; result provenance и loser accounting.
acceptance.error: QUORUM-02: all failures/no attainable quorum/invalid k/tie produce typed deterministic outcome.
acceptance.concurrency: QUORUM-03: simultaneous completions/cancel/deadline one winner, losers acknowledged/uncertain честно.

cards.non_goals: Unbounded best-of-N spending, hidden judge success, новый scheduler.

cards.title: MCP tool adapter
cards.behavior: Pin MCP version/transports, lifecycle/auth/tools schema/artifact normalization, bounded timeout/output/permissions and server capability report. Discovery не execute tools и не предоставляет лишние rights.

acceptance.normal: MCP-01: local fixture server tools/resources translated into typed registry and native loop.
acceptance.error: MCP-02: auth/schema/protocol mismatch/disallowed tool/server disconnect explicit errors.
acceptance.concurrency: MCP-03: cancel request/session close/late tool output status, no orphan server processes or widened child permissions.

cards.non_goals: Unlimited remote servers/plugins, protocol support без version conformance, bypass CI sandbox policy.

cards.title: yb harness connect raider
cards.behavior: Managed Raider config adapter/registry/connect/disconnect/doctor. Preserve permissions/user settings/backups, references на keys, drift и version schema. Wrapper-first CI already works без этого PR.

acceptance.normal: YB-01: connect twice идемпотентно; disconnect restores config, doctor verifies deployed capabilities.
acceptance.error: YB-02: config drift/schema conflict/helper returns parent in required mode fail without overwrite.
acceptance.concurrency: YB-03: atomic config transaction interrupted mid-write retains recoverable backup and no key literals.

cards.non_goals: Менять Raider runtime, platform scheduler, silent auth fallback.
